documents.title: About K. Ramakrishnan College of Engineering
documents.content: K. Ramakrishnan College of Engineering (KRCE) was established in 2008 and is located at Samayapuram, Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu. The official website describes a 30-acre campus and affiliation to Anna University, Chennai.

documents.title: Admissions and eligibility information
documents.content: KRCE publishes admissions information and programme details on its official website. Confirm current eligibility, deadlines, fees and scholarship conditions from the latest official admissions page.

documents.title: Computer Science and Engineering
documents.content: The CSE department was established in 2008. Its official page describes UG and PG programmes and focus areas including AI, Data Science, Cyber Security, Cloud Computing and Software Engineering.

documents.title: Controller of Examinations
documents.content: The KRCE examination page publishes exam updates, timetables and result notices. Use the official page for current schedules, revaluation instructions and results.

documents.title: Campus facilities
documents.content: The official KRCE infrastructure page lists hostel, transport, library, gymnasium, sports, medical facilities and cafeteria. Contact the relevant campus office for current availability and rules.

documents.title: Information Technology department
documents.content: The KRCE IT department page describes learning areas including software development, data analytics, AI, cloud computing, IoT and networking.

documents.title: Central Library overview
documents.content: KRCE Central Library is described as covering 2,412 square metres, with study space, air conditioning, a digital library with internet-enabled computers, printed collections and audio-visual materials. Check the official page for current services and hours.

faqs.question: How can I contact KRCE?
faqs.answer: The official contact page lists +91 98429 91377 and info@krce.ac.in. Verify current details on the official site.

faqs.question: Where can I find library details?
faqs.answer: Use the official KRCE library page for facilities, services and current information.

faqs.question: Where is KRCE located?
faqs.answer: K. Ramakrishnan College of Engineering is at NH 45, Samayapuram, Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu 621112.
